[Benzinga news, 2026-10-22T18:02:00Z, by staff] Blackstone Leads $300 Million Debt Financing for Gooch & Housego Buyout
Blackstone has reportedly led a $300 million debt financing package to support the buyout of Gooch & Housego.
Blackstone has led a $300 million debt package to facilitate the buyout of Gooch & Housego. This financing activity reflects the firm's ongoing involvement in private credit and debt markets. The transaction was reported on October 22, 2026.
